fusions.name: Through the Glass
fusions.desc: Fires a round at an enemy up to 11 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Spotted Flaw
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: fires at an enemy up to 8 tiles away for 8 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding half their remaining damage to the shot.

fusions.name: Zeroed In
fusions.desc: Your attacks and spells reach 54% further for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Tracking Gaze
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a second blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
